errors.text_span: Етикетите са разположени на всеки половин годин, и представляват години.
errors.evidence: The x-axis labels are for each year (2005, 2006, 2007, etc.), not every half year.

errors.text_span: Тя започва при стойност около 900 хиляди кв. м. през 2005 г.
errors.evidence: The value in 2005 is approximately 830 thousand sq. m., not 900.

errors.text_span: и достига връх около 1380 хиляди кв. м. през 2006 г.
errors.evidence: The chart shows that the value in 2006 is approximately 980 thousand sq. m. and is rising. The overall peak of the entire period is in 2009 at approximately 1400 thousand sq. m. The description misidentifies both the year and the value of the peak.

errors.text_span: След това стойността намалява до около 1000 хиляди кв. м. през 2008 г.
errors.evidence: The chart shows the value increasing between 2006 and 2008, reaching approximately 1380 thousand sq. m. in 2008. The description incorrectly states that the value decreases.

errors.text_span: след което отново набъбва до около 1200 хиляди кв. м. през 2010 г.
errors.evidence: The chart shows a decrease after the 2009 peak. The value in 2010 is approximately 1050 thousand sq. m., not 1200. The description incorrectly states that the value increases ('набъбва').

errors.text_span: След това стойността намалява, достига връх около 1100 хиляди кв. м. през 2012 г.
errors.evidence: This statement is contradictory and factually incorrect. In 2012, the value is at a local minimum of approximately 780 thousand sq. m., not a peak of 1100.

errors.text_span: Стойността намалява до около 700 хиляди кв. м. през 2021 г.
errors.evidence: The chart clearly shows the value increasing towards the end of the period, reaching approximately 1150 thousand sq. m. in 2021, not decreasing to 700.
